reviewCamera.name: review-3q-port-aft
reviewCamera.purpose: design review only; NOT the production film camera

status: provisionally-approved-direction; subject to Codex independent review and final appearance approval

identity.specId: sha256 of vessel.json content (key order as authored, whitespace-insensitive)
identity.generatorId: sha256 of generate.mjs with line endings normalised to LF
identity.massingModelId: sha256 of [solid name, material, GLB float32 positions rounded to 1 mm] for every solid in GLB order; recomputable from the GLB alone
identity.cameraId: sha256 of the review camera (projection, transform, framing, crop); review only
identity.productionIdentityContract: A future production model id must bind: the approved specId and massingModelId it was built to, the production mesh/scene file hashes, every source asset in the bill of materials (licence + sha256), and the production film camera identity (intrinsics, extrinsics, sensor/crop and object-fit masks per WP-01). Review-camera identity is not the production camera identity.

canonicalModel.representation: closed triangle solids built once in generate.mjs from vessel.json; the GLB, overlay faces and sheets 01–05, 07 are views of the same triangles; sheets 06, 08–10 use the same side-line functions
intentionallyOmitted: railings and terrace balustrades (except the D9 glass windscreen)
anchors, mooring gear and shell doors
hull windows, mullions, stripes and funnel louvres (drawn as markings)
sculpted swept funnel casing (simplified to a raked block)
aft-wall glazing of the terrace levels
cabin balconies as recesses (the side glazing band stands for balcony glass)

capacity.rule: A slot is valid only if, over its complete footprint (sampled every 0.05 m), corridorHalfWidth + corridorBulkhead + interiorDepth + balconyDepth (balcony decks; cabinVariants override it for the listed cabins only) + sideStructureAllowance ≤ the local side line of its level (decks 5–7: superstructure side; deck 4: hull side − hullLining).

taperedVariant.rule: same slot and full 7.2 m interior; balcony reduced to the local forward taper; these cabins only

hullFit.rule: corridor bulkhead 0.12 + interior 7.2 + balcony 2.1 + side structure 0.10, minimum over the full footprint

viewpoints.note: from the door: passage, bed and the sea through the sliding doors
looking back to the bed and the bathroom wall
open sea over the glass balustrade
back into the cabin through the open doors to the bed

entertainmentLounge.basis: fictional design target: 1.8 m² per seated guest after a 15 % circulation allowance; not a certified occupancy
entertainmentLounge.sideLine: hull side at deck 4 (z 10) minus 0.3 m lining

note: Hashes identify this proposal revision. The approved specId/massingModelId pair is frozen only after the P1 defects are independently re-reviewed and the owner approves (vessel.json 1.0.0).
